title: Rust DIO admission accepts unicast dst; Python requires exactly ff02::1a (spec 09 13.3)
description: Second divergence noted by worker6-b7z9.15 (hop-limit bead, whose fix landed separately). Python admission (python/src/lichen/rpl/authenticated_dio.py:359-360) rejects any authenticated DIO whose destination is not exactly ff02::1a. Rust admission (rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs authenticated_dio_destination_is_local, ~:2108-2153) admits ff02::1a broadcast OR unicast-to-local-link destinations. Cross-impl divergence: the same wire DIO is admitted by Rust and rejected by Python. Also a hardening gap: authenticated DIOs aimed at a unicast address still mutate parent selection in the Rust node. Decide the canonical contract (likely: require exactly ff02::1a to match Python and RFC 6550 multicast-DIO semantics), fix Rust, mirror the Python test case dio_payload(destination=IPv6Address('fe80::1')). Discovered during correctness+security codereview of the b7z9.15 hop-limit fix; codec.rs comment on the hop-limit check points here.
close_reason: Rust admission now requires destination exactly ff02::1a, matching the Python reference (authenticated_dio.py:359-360) and spec 09 13.3: removed the unicast-to-local-link branch from the destination gate (renamed authenticated_dio_destination_is_local -> authenticated_dio_destination_is_canonical_multicast in rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs; both entry points issue_from_authenticated_dio and from_authenticated_dio_frame share the one gate). Tests in rust/lichen-schc/tests/authenticated_dio_vectors.rs: fe80::1-dst broadcast frame rejected InvalidPeerEvidence (Rule 255 encoding so the dst conjunct is the discriminator), Extended-addr unicast link frame to the receiver rejected (regression guard for the deleted branch — old code admitted this shape), ff02::1a controls admitted. Migrated rust/lichen-schc/tests/adaptation_vectors.rs vector_peer_authority off the removed branch (broadcast frame + ff02::1a dst) per reviewer P1. Gates: cargo test -p lichen-schc green under --features std AND std,raw-fragment-codec,test-utils; clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; fmt drift at codec.rs 293/1447/2182 verified pre-existing (worker-4 preflight/kpv0 scope). The 7 lichen-node rpl_stack test failures observed during verification are pre-existing at HEAD (verified via stash) — tracked under 5fva/dp72 family, unrelated. Codereview: 4 Kimi K3 passes — correctness (P1 adaptation_vectors reliance: fixed in-change; P3 vacuous test: replaced with discriminating guard; P4 name: fixed), edge-cases (P2 same test coverage point: fixed), security (found pre-existing AddrMode-conjunct over-tightening vs Python: filed as worker6-i8cd), confirmation (two P4 comment-wording items: fixed inline). Findings that were out-of-scope filed as beads, in-diff defects fixed and re-reviewed to convergence.
